_comment: THE REPLAY HUNT'S LARGEST CLUSTER, C6 (103 of 295 failures) -- 'the loop runs to completion
and the finisher never activates once'.  This is the user's `claude_s10_gi9` turn-4 board
(hunt id RR-0a59241227), reconstructed.
Brushland = 1, Brushland (+Fertile Ground +Wild Growth) = 3, Kitchen = 1, Mariposa = 1: six
mana a tap.  Peregrine Drake untaps up to FIVE, so every blink recovers all four lands, and
Eldrazi Displacer's {2}{C} is {C} under Training Grounds -- net +5 a pass.  The kill is rule
WISH-DRAW: dig with Kitchen's '{4},{T}: Investigate' until a Living Wish turns up, wish for a
finisher and cash the loop into it.
WHY IT USED TO DRAW NOTHING AT ALL.  A card off the Investigate route costs SIX -- the {4}
activation plus the Clue's own {2} -- and the iteration only has five to spend once the blink's
{C} is kept back.  SpendSurplusOnDrawSinks cracked its Clues at the BOTTOM of the routine,
after activating every {T} source, so each iteration spent its whole budget making a Clue it
could not then crack, the ETB untap refilled the board, and the next iteration made ANOTHER
one in front of the Clue still sitting there.  MTG_EDF_LOOP_TRACE printed the same two lines
eighteen times:
k=N enter           cost={C} float{}  avail{g1 c1 *4}
k=N post-draw-sink  cost={C} float{}  avail{c1}
-- eighteen iterations, eighteen Clues, ZERO cards drawn, and [finish] `calls=18
none-found=18 wish=0`.  The loop was healthy and the mana was there; the dig never produced a
single card, which is why the cluster reads as a finisher-SELECTION defect from the counters
alone.
MTG_COMBO_OFF_CRACK_FIRST cracks the Clues already in play before making another.  A Clue is a
card already paid for except for {2}, so it buys a card at a quarter of a fresh Investigate,
and it carries the same keep_payable real trial, so it cannot starve the loop.  The iteration
then alternates (crack, Investigate, crack, ...) and the dig runs.
A/B ON THE REAL REPLAY (one binary, the hunt's own repro):
default                            -> COMBO OFF wins on turn 4
MTG_COMBO_OFF_CRACK_FIRST=0        -> the click does nothing; the game is won on turn 8
This fixture must be OFFERED and VERIFIED, and it must FAIL with the lever at 0.
_library_comment: The Living Wish is SIX cards down, so the dig has to run and cannot be satisfied by the
leading crack alone: at one card per two iterations the loop needs about twelve of its
iterations before the wish is in hand, and the rest to deploy Essence Depleter and drain.
